name: Cross-model persona consistency
definition: Evaluates whether anonymized outputs from three student models preserve the same core persona behavior.
anonymization: Model names are randomized into System A/B/C and resolved from metadata after judging.

score_scales.5: Virtually the same persona behavior across all sets.
score_scales.4: Minor stylistic differences but same persona.
score_scales.3: Noticeable differences; some sets capture persona better than others.

aggregation_formula: mean(overall_cross_model) by task plus best_set/worst_set vote counts after label resolution
